consequent.text: Karakamsa falling in Meena (Pisces): an inspirational, righteous nature.

quote:
An inspirational 
and righteous nature is revealed if Karakamsa happens to 
fallin Meena.

consequent.text: Ketu in the 2nd from Karakamsa (aspected by malefics): weak expression, an indistinct speaker.

quote:
One lacks power of expression, 
or will be an indistinct speaker if the 2nd from Kara- 
kamsa is occupied by Ketu and aspected by malefics.

consequent.text: Ketu joining the Karakamsa: sinful deeds and hypocrisy.

quote:
The person commits sinful deeds and 
becomes a hypocrite if Ketu joins Karakamsa

consequent.text: Malefics in the 3rd from Karakamsa: a brave nature.

quote:
Malefics in the 3rd from. 
Karakamsa make one brave.

consequent.text: Saturn in the Karakamsa or the 5th from it: great nervousness in assemblies.

quote:
Saturn in 
Karakamsa or in the Sth from it indicates Breat ner- 
vøusness in assemblies.

consequent.text: Sun and Rahu in the Karakamsa (aspected by Mars): a destructive temperament.

quote:
the 
Sun and Rahu in Karakamsa aspected by Mars confers a 
destructive temperament

highest number of degrees in a sign. Chandra or the 
Moon is however the natural karaka of mother.

largest number of degrees devoid of the signs.

consequent.text: Jaimini has 7 chara (movable) karakas — Atma, Amatya, Bhratru, Matru, Putra, Gnathi, Dara — assigned by degree-in-sign, any planet able to acquire any karakatwa.

quote:
There are 7 main karakas in Jaimini, viz., 
(1) Atma, (2) Amatya, (3) Bhratru, (4) Matru, (5) Putra, 
(6) Gnathi and (7) Dara.

consequent.text: Jupiter in the Karakamsa or the 5th from it: proficiency in grammar, the Vedas and the Vedangas.

quote:
Jupiter in Karakamsa orjin 
the 5th from it gives proficiency in grammar, Vedas and 
Vedangas.

ambiguity_notes: The distinguishing 'aspected by Jupiter' clause is in the karakamsa frame, which the aspect leaves do not reckon; only the presence of an education combination is encoded, so this over-fires without the Jupiter aspect.

consequent.text: When any of the Karakamsa education combinations is also aspected by Jupiter, the person becomes a versatile genius.

quote:
When the above combinations are 
aspected by Jupiter, the person becomes a versatile genius.

consequent.text: Ketu in the Karakamsa or the 5th from it: proficiency in mathematics.

quote:
Ketu in Karakamsa or in the 5th from it gives proficieney 
in mathematics.

consequent.text: Mars in the Karakamsa or the 5th from it: high legal education.

quote:
Mars in Karakamsa or in 
the Sth from it gives high legal education.

consequent.text: Mercury in the Karakamsa or the 5th from it: good insight into Meemamsa (philosophy of interpretation).

quote:
Mercury in Karakamsa or 5th from it indicates 
a good insight into Meemamsa.

consequent.text: The Moon in the Karakamsa or the 5th from it: makes a musician, or a scholar of literature.

quote:
When the 
Moon is in Karakamsa or in the Sth from it, it makes 
one a musician or gives him scholarship in literature.

consequent.text: Benefics associated with (or aspecting) the Arudha Lagna: the native becomes wealthy.

quote:
lf Arudha Lagna is associated with or aspected 
by benefics, the native becomes wealthy.

consequent.text: Venus, the Moon and Jupiter together in the 2nd from the Arudha Lagna: considerable wealth.

quote:
There will be 
considerable wealth if the 2nd from Lagnarudha is occu- 
pied by Venus, Moon and Jupiter.
